summary: Crook County, OR site: 40-ft wooden tower with L-4 cab built 1934-35, removed 1955; four concrete footings remain on the summit, per a May 2026 hiker.

access.note: Reached on foot up Road 200 from Road 4225. A May 2026 hiker mentions no gate or permit and calls the road a closed route.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, firelookout.com and the 2026 blog give 1935. Forest Lookouts says the tower and L-4 cab were completed in 1934, and the register's panorama photo is dated 10-15-1934. The story says the sources disagree.
The register and the blog say the tower was removed in 1955; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1955. Same year, different wording.

notes_for_editor: No staffing names found for Lutsey Point, so staffing is omitted. The only description of the site today is one visitor's May 2026 blog post; it is cited as such. The access note is an inference from the blog's walk up a road it calls closed, so check Ochoco NF status before publishing the access line.
